summary: Full backend + frontend testing for AI Sathi English ↔ Nepali translator. All 9 pytest cases for /api/translate and /api/translate-image passed. Playwright mobile-viewport test covered header/language-pill/placeholder/empty-state, debounced EN→NE translation, swap, copy, TTS button toggle, translate-now NE→EN, clear, and gallery/camera wiring — all passed without JS crashes.

issues: React Native deprecation warnings in console (non-blocking): 'shadow*' style props -> use boxShadow; TouchableWithoutFeedback -> use Pressable; props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents; ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions -> ImagePicker.MediaType.

action_items: Optional: silence RN web deprecation warnings (boxShadow, Pressable, ImagePicker.MediaType) to keep console clean — does not affect functionality.
Optional: align expo-clipboard/expo-image-picker/expo-speech versions to those recommended by Expo doctor for best compat (installed 55.x vs expected 8.x/17.x/14.x as reported by expo).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: JSON parsing of OCR response is robust (handles ```json fences and fallback). Good.
server.py: swap-same-language short-circuit returns original text correctly.
index.tsx: debounce (600ms) works; callTranslate properly handles loading/error/success states.
index.tsx: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is read from env; no hardcoded URLs.
seed_data_creation: None. Backend is stateless (no DB usage).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend exposed at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://nepali-ocr-speak.preview.emergentagent.com). Use Pillow to build real PNG with visible text for /api/translate-image tests (see test_translator_api._make_text_png_b64). Gemini OCR responses can take 15-30s; use timeout >=60s. Frontend testIDs: app-header-logo, source-text-input, translated-text-output, language-swap-button, clear-text-button, translate-now-button, copy-clipboard-button, play-audio-button, gallery-upload-button, camera-capture-button, speak-source-button.
rca_of_issue: No issues found. EN->NE returned 'शुभ प्रभात' for 'Good morning'; NE->EN returned 'I want water' for 'मलाई पानी चाहियो'; OCR on synthesized 'HELLO WORLD' PNG returned English detected_lang + Devanagari translation.
